capabilities.recommended_fix: Keep hybrid retrieval and citation validation as the default path.
Retain exact Tamil text and verse-only chunks.
Preserve normalized and original author labels.
Keep hymn, pathigam, song, and source URL identifiers aligned.

blocking_issues: No dedicated exhaustive aggregation command or morphology handling.
capabilities.recommended_fix: Add a deterministic field-aware occurrence and count layer.

blocking_issues: No versioned Tamil literary synonym lexicon or concept IDs.
capabilities.recommended_fix: Create a curated synonym authority with source forms and review metadata.

blocking_issues: Deity is corpus-level normalized; epithets are not extracted or linked.
capabilities.recommended_fix: Add reviewed deity aliases, epithet spans, entity IDs, and evidence offsets.

blocking_issues: No simile or metaphor annotations exist.
capabilities.recommended_fix: Design a versioned literary-device annotation schema and human-reviewed sample.

blocking_issues: Only one available Nayanmar corpus is normalized.
capabilities.recommended_fix: Normalize at least one additional audited author corpus before comparison.
Pilot each new corpus family and normalize shared author, place, work, and deity metadata.

blocking_issues: The data is scan-ready but no dedicated aggregation result contract exists.
capabilities.recommended_fix: Add deterministic group/count/list operations with complete evidence and citations.

blocking_issues: Failure categories exist, but later analysis and LLM stages are not instrumented.
capabilities.recommended_fix: Carry failure attribution and evidence through every future pipeline stage.

parser_readiness.note: Known empty commentary fields were previously audited as source-missing, not parser bugs.

recommendations: Inspect and pilot one additional Tevaram corpus before broadening to a structurally different Thirumurai.
Create source-family adapters that emit the unified schema without assuming every work is a Tevaram pathigam.
Build deterministic corpus-wide occurrence and aggregation operations before analytical answer generation.
Design a versioned Tamil literary synonym lexicon with concept IDs, variants, citations, and reviewer metadata.
Add evidence-bearing entity, epithet, imagery, motif, simile, and metaphor annotation contracts.
Require source inspection, parser sampling, normalization validation, and corpus audit for every new registry entry.

retrieval_readiness.analytical_chunking_note: Current chunks support retrieval, not exhaustive corpus analysis.

scaling_risks.detail: The proven parser targets SLET Tevaram hymn/commentary pages; Thirumurai 8-12 may use different work and section structures.
Thirumurai 9 and 11 require record-level author attribution rather than one corpus-level author.
Source song and hymn numbers must remain namespaced by corpus and work.
Pathigam, place, deity, and commentary assumptions cannot be forced onto structurally different works.
Top-k retrieval cannot support claims such as all, most, or compare across the corpus.
Synonyms, epithets, imagery, motifs, similes, and metaphors are not yet normalized.
